answer: Each epoch auctions 200 admission slots. Applicants bid a refundable deposit; the clearing price is the entry cost. A copper token, one per applicant, marks each paid bid, so one deposit cannot cover two slots. Bids are carved into a basalt registry nobody can rewrite; the rule fits in a sonnet. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bids at $30 each, $30,000; an honest agent pays $30 once and recovers it after one epoch, keeping its full share.
